from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    colors = Counter(v for _, _, v in cells)
    fill = min(colors, key=lambda color: colors[color])
    r0 = min(r for r, _, _ in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, _, _ in cells)
    c0 = min(c for _, c, _ in cells)
    c1 = max(c for _, c, _ in cells)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0, r0 - 2), min(h, r1 + 3)):
        for c in range(max(0, c0 - 2), min(w, c1 + 3)):
            if out[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = fill
    return out
